summary: Roadside rest area pull-off by a roundabout, used by other vehicles but exposed to traffic.

best_section.where: the grass/gravel pull-off between the loop driveway and the main road, roughly 15-20m north-east of the pin, where other caravans and trailers are already parked

drivers.seclusion: Open rest area under tree canopy; picnic shelters (not houses) sit in the centre loop, so no dwelling nearby, but the site is a visible, used public stop rather than a hidden one.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed loop driveway off the roundabout with a flat pull-off area; plenty of room, and other long vehicles (caravans/trailers) are already parked there.
drivers.traffic: Sits right beside a roundabout on what looks like a dual-carriageway arterial road, so there will be passing traffic and some road noise, though trees buffer the view.
drivers.convention: Other vehicles, including what look like caravans or boat trailers, are already parked on the grass near the road, suggesting this is an accepted stopping spot.

flags: Beside a roundabout on a busier road - some traffic noise likely
Public rest area with shelters, so possibly visited by others
sun_shade: Dense eucalypt canopy covers most of the loop and shelters; the pull-off nearer the road is more open to sun.
cannot_judge: Whether there are no-camping or rest-area time-limit signs on site
Exact kerb/verge height for the pull-off
